es: Reconstruir el orden real de los hechos en una anécdota que salta entre tiempos, distinguiendo la línea principal del fondo anterior y de lo que sucedería después.

teaching.en: Years earlier, her father had promised to take her to the city, and she had never forgotten it.
teaching.es: Años antes, su padre le había prometido llevarla a la ciudad, y ella nunca lo había olvidado.
teaching.explanationEs: Past perfect (had promised): un hecho anterior al momento que se cuenta; years earlier lo señala.

feedback.es: El retraso del tren de su prima y las dos horas de espera son anteriores al encuentro; la promesa del padre sigue sin cumplirse y la boda es posterior.

origin.audio: I must have been about twenty. By the time the last train arrived, I had been waiting on the platform for nearly two hours, because my cousin's train had been delayed by snow. Years earlier, my father had promised to take me to the city, and I suppose I wanted to prove that I could manage alone. Then a stranger offered me his umbrella. I did not know it then, but I would marry him three years later.

prompt.es: Completa: «Entonces no lo sabía, pero se casaría con él y vivirían cincuenta años allí.»

feedback.es: Would + verbo base anticipa, desde el pasado, algo que ocurrirá después de la escena que se cuenta.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué el abuelo nunca devolvió el reloj.

choices.text: He lost it soon after he left and kept that a secret.
He preferred to keep it, since it reminded him of his village.
He could not keep his promise because she died before his return.
She had asked him to give it to his own children.

feedback.es: El abuelo había prometido devolver el reloj, pero su madre falleció antes de que él volviera (passed away before I came home): la promesa quedó imposible de cumplir.

origin.audio: My grandfather rarely talked about his youth, so it was a surprise when, at a family party, he handed me a small silver watch. “Your great-grandmother gave it to me the night I left the village,” he said. “By then, she had been saving for it for over a year, and she made me promise to bring it back. As it turned out, I never returned it: she passed away before I came home. That watch would stay in my pocket for sixty years. Now it is yours.” I had never seen him so serious. The room went quiet, and even the children stopped playing.

feedback.es: Years before that es lo más antiguo (la promesa), three months earlier sitúa la renuncia después, y la espera de cinco horas es lo más reciente.

origin.audio: My aunt was waiting at the airport when the announcement came. By then she had been sitting there for five hours. Three months earlier she had quit her job, and years before that she had promised her mother that she would one day return to the island. When the plane finally landed, she stood up and, as it turned out, she would never leave the island again.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud muestra la tía ante lo que ha descubierto?

choices.text: Curious and a little wistful about what Grandma kept to herself.
Angry that Grandma kept a secret from the family.
Anxious that more secrets will damage the family.
Happy that the secret turned out to be so small.

feedback.es: «I'm not upset» descarta el enojo, y «I just wonder what else she never told us» muestra curiosidad con cierta nostalgia; no hay preocupación por la familia ni alegría.

origin.text: Dear Leo, something has come to light while I was clearing Grandma's kitchen. Do you remember the old box where she kept her recipes? I always assumed they were hers. As it turned out, half of them were written by a woman none of us had heard of, and Grandma had copied them out for sixty years without a word. I'm not upset. I just wonder what else she never told us.
